name: Site safety induction pack
summary: For one named site, the site, facilities or people lead gets an induction built from that site's own emergency arrangements, rules and hazards, with a short check of understanding, a sign-off record for each person and refresher dates by role. A competent person approves it and delivers it.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for this work: the hazard and people lists with stated column headers and a stop when one does not match; hazards matched to roles through the roles named against each; one question per subject and per hazard with an answer key that cites the site's document; walk-round places drawn from the documents and demonstrations set by the company; a pass rule with one re-explanation; old sources, contradicting documents and hazards held only by rules and protective equipment raised as points, with no control added; a refresher on return after time away; health details referred outside the pack; and no law or standard cited.

sources.contribution: A named site and its own hazards required before any pack is written; content, a signed record for each person and refreshers by role as the three parts; hazard controls ordered strongest first, with protective equipment never the unquestioned whole answer; names kept to the signed record and health details kept out; permits for contractors, inducted after prequalification.

The five subjects every induction covers and what belongs in each; a subject the site cannot fill shown as a gap; how contractors and employees differ in what they need; riskier roles refreshed more often and after a change of rules or an incident.

What to settle before drafting: who is being inducted, which site, which arrangements and hazards are available and where the hazards come from, with a date, how it is delivered, how understanding is checked, who owns it and how often it is repeated; nothing drafted until the site, its emergency arrangements and one hazard are known; the site documents that feed a pack.
The checks before a pack goes out: nothing generic, every subject tied to the site, controls ranked, a record for each person with the check method named, and every refresher owned and dated.
The ways an induction quietly fails: a signature treated as proof of understanding, a subject listed without the detail a person needs, one pack for every group, and a refresher nobody owns.
Personal and health details found and flagged before anything is drafted, and kept to the minimum the purpose needs; the same ideas are also stated in the package's main file and its review notes.
The hard cases of an induction meant for any site, a request to accept attendance alone, and a health detail in a copy that circulates, used here as acceptance tests in new scenarios.

The order of the finished pack, from site and audience through content, hazards, the record for each person and refreshers to sign-off; refreshers counted from the induction date, and contractors refreshed at each job.

The setting of its worked warehouse induction, a site where forklifts and pedestrians are kept apart by walkways, with an alarm and an assembly point in the car park, which the invented chilled-food depot in the example echoes; the depot, its cold store, dock, charging bay, plant room, contractor and people are new.
